name: unrestricted-realtime-with-render-efficient-loading
changes: Removed the no-listener Render guard that disconnected idle customer realtime sessions.
Connect now stays usable; the server performs the normal live availability check instead of blocking the button to conserve Render usage.
Removed the two-customer-socket cap while keeping authenticated realtime reconnect protection against scripted abuse.
Kept lazy dashboard loading and visibility-aware background refreshes so normal functionality stays unrestricted without wasteful API bursts.
Listener presence and profile broadcasts are now sent only to customer sockets instead of every connected portal.
Direct-message refresh is notification-driven with a one-minute visible-page fallback instead of frequent polling.
Listener profile and banner responses use version-safe browser caching, and listener cards load the first 10 images first with later images lazy-loaded.
Public showcase data now permits short browser/CDN caching instead of being forced to refetch on every landing-page visit.
All portal/service-worker cache versions were bumped so the optimized files replace stale cached builds.
notes: Normal customer realtime presence remains connected even when no listener is currently online.
The global API safety limiter remains as an abuse safeguard; it does not intentionally disable normal calling or wallet usage.
Run the normal database initialization during deployment.
